payload.supporting_quote: ELISA revealed significant elevation of CHI3L1 in the CSF of multiple sclerosis (MS) patients
Serum YKL-40 and IFN-γ concentrations were elevated in MS group compared the healthy subjects, but the difference was not significantly.
At baseline, MS patients had markedly higher CSF concentrations of Galectin-9 and YKL-40 and slightly higher GDF-15 than controls.

CSF YKL-40 was increased in patients with active relapsing-remitting MS and correlated with the number of gadolinium enhancing lesions. Patients with secondary progressive MS had similar high levels of YKL-40, whereas not active relapsing-remitting MS patients had YKL-40 levels comparable to healthy controls.
CSF levels of YKL-40 were increased in MS during relapse, remission and secondary progression compared with healthy controls.
